create_bilstm_doc_slot_attention: create a BiLSTMDocSlotAttention module with config and embedding dimension for sequence representation
build_doc_attention_with_pooling: build a BiLSTMDocSlotAttention model with pooling config to produce fixed-sized document representations
configure_slot_attention_for_words: configure BiLSTMDocSlotAttention with slot attention to produce fixed-sized word representations from LSTM output
run_forward_pass_bilstm: run a forward pass on embedded tokens through BiLSTMDocSlotAttention to get document and word representations
review_bilstm_config_options: review the BiLSTMDocSlotAttention Config class to understand dropout, lstm, pooling, and slot attention options
